item.description: The wacky condiments making their way onto Gen Z’s Christmas dinners this year include hot sauce and sriracha (36 per cent), salad cream (25 per cent), and even curry sauce (39 per cent).

item.title: Snow need to stop swimming this winter: Local baby swim school busts cold-weather myths
item.description: As winter settles in and the layers pile up, many parents assume swimming lessons should take a break too. Cold days and warm babies don’t always feel like a natural match. But while we bundle up outdoors, the pool tells a different story. When it comes to baby swimming, winter isn’t something to avoid – it’s actually one of the safest, cosiest and most rewarding times to keep little ones splashing.

item.title: Global leaders launch panel to accelerate action to end gender-based violence
item.description: New report calls for coordinated leadership, sustained financing, and system-wide prevention to confront a global crisis affecting over one billion women and girls.

item.title: Double century celebrations at Launton Grange Care Home
item.description: HC-One’s Launton Grange Care Home in Bicester, Oxfordshire, has marked a remarkable milestone, celebrating not one but two centenarian birthdays. Residents Catherine “Kate” Nicholls and Barbara Marsh both reached their 100th birthdays in November, with staff, families, and the local community joining together to ensure the occasions were truly unforgettable.
